description: Pengu Local MCP server — scoped fs, Chrome URL open, allowlisted app launch, restricted shell (allowlist runner, not a sandbox). Owner: M4.

policyNotes.denyByDefault: Anything not explicitly allowlisted or inside granted scopes fails closed.
policyNotes.approvalToken: shell_run_restricted verifies the HMAC token injected by M1 via the reserved request _meta field (penguApproval). The token is never a model-visible argument and never reaches the UI.
policyNotes.verifiability: fs_create_folder is locally verifiable (folder exists). browser_open_url and app_launch are not locally verifiable: resume marks them unknown and asks the user.
policyNotes.sandbox: This server is an allowlist runner, not an OS-level sandbox. It does not contain a determined attacker; it prevents the agent from running anything outside the allowlist.

tools.name: fs_create_folder
tools.description: Create a directory inside an approved root only. Idempotent: existing directory returns success with alreadyExisted:true. Rejects .. traversal and symlink escapes.

input.path: string (absolute within an approved root, or relative to the default root)

tools.name: fs_list_dir
tools.description: List one directory inside an approved root. Returns names and types only (capped); never reads file contents.

tools.name: browser_open_url
tools.description: Open an HTTP/HTTPS URL in Chrome. Other schemes (file:, javascript:, ...) are refused; URLs with embedded credentials are refused.

tools.name: app_launch
tools.description: Launch an allowlisted application by app ID from config. Unknown IDs are denied.

tools.name: shell_describe_command
tools.description: READ: resolve an allowlisted command ID into the exact-action preview (purpose, resolved cwd, argv, impact, reversibility, timeout, output cap). Unknown command IDs and invalid args are denied here.

input.args: optional object of validated string arguments

tools.name: shell_run_restricted
tools.description: CONSEQUENTIAL: run an allowlisted command ID with validated arguments, fixed cwd, timeout, capped output and no elevation. Requires a valid, unexpired exact-action HMAC approval token (injected by M1 via _meta). Unknown commands or bad args are denied even if the user would approve.

input.args: optional object; only declared args with matching patterns are accepted

tools.resolvedArgs: argsHash is computed over {commandId, args, cwd} (contract 7.3)
